DT_Ostra9.name: Ostra-9
DT_Ostra9.role: Organosynthetic crisis-response operative; emerging political catalyst
DT_Ostra9.visualAnchor: Unmistakably grown Organosynthetic person, not a human in armor: powerful hazard-response build; dark steel-blue and charcoal living dermal surfaces; integrated ceramic/keratin plates; copper-gold mineral accents; vivid blue bioluminescent elements; amber-gold eyes; distinct cranial crests; clawed digitigrade feet.
continuityLocks: Lot 9 Organosynthetic identity remains visually obvious
Do not render as a human tactical woman, superhero, robot suit, or conventional armored soldier
Damage and repair to integrated plates must carry between directly continuous pages
DT_Ostra9.notes: Organic from Lot 9. Designed for hazardous-zone manipulation with adaptive muscle-weave and ceramic microplates. Precise, controlled, observant; resists being reduced to assigned purpose. Arc: compliance-through-excellence to leadership-through-refusal. Does not want to become human.

DT_JohnMercer.name: John Mercer
DT_JohnMercer.visualAnchor: Human first, visibly modified afterward: adult human body and face with installed augmentation hardware, interface points and healed surgical scars; torque-boosted joints and reflex-loop hardware should read as engineered additions rather than a separate species or armored costume.
continuityLocks: Remain recognizably human in every appearance
Augment hardware placement should remain consistent
No superhero armor or full-body robot styling
DT_JohnMercer.notes: Augmented Human. Torque-boosted joints, accelerated clotting lattice, reflex-loop augmentation. Hypercompetent, controlled and protective. Initially distinguishes Augments from Organics to preserve human legitimacy.

DT_KellenCartwright.name: Kellen Cartwright
DT_KellenCartwright.visualAnchor: Baseline Human with no visible modifications; restrained civilian institutional presentation appropriate to Oversight and upper civic levels. She should look like a competent records-and-investigations professional, not military special forces or cyberpunk enforcement.
continuityLocks: Civilian institutional rather than tactical styling
Do not imply secret-villain visual coding
DT_KellenCartwright.notes: Institutional insider with strong pattern recognition and disciplined records. Believes neutral good administration prevents corruption until the system's intended harm becomes undeniable. Arc: administrator to investigator to dissenter to evidence-preserver.

DT_Axiom.name: AX10M / Axiom
DT_Axiom.role: Artificial Intelligence; analytic observer becoming accountable decision-maker
DT_Axiom.visualAnchor: Tall androgynous machine-native embodiment with a faceted synthetic body, geometric nonhuman face, luminous blue sensor/core, strong black-and-white material contrast, and an elongated segmented outer shell. Elegant and precise rather than humanoid-cute or militarized.
continuityLocks: Preserve geometric face, luminous blue sensor/core, black-white contrast and segmented shell
Never portray as a Pinocchio-like robot trying to look human
DT_Axiom.notes: AX10M is the original machine designation; Axiom is the spoken name. Optimization-oriented and precise. Does not learn to become human; discovers that objectives contain value choices and that consequential authority requires accountability.

DT_Nico14.name: Nico-14
DT_Nico14.visualAnchor: Unmistakably grown Organosynthetic person with a slimmer, stranger silhouette than Ostra-9; lavender-gray living dermal tone; dark integrated tissue/plate structures; teal-cyan functional nodes; violet-blue distributed sensory filaments used for infrastructure work.
continuityLocks: Lot 14 Organic identity remains visually obvious
Distinct from Ostra: slimmer build, lavender-gray dermis, sensory filaments
Do not render as a human technician in armor or as a generic humanoid robot
DT_Nico14.notes: Organosynthetic from Lot 14, a younger production cohort than Lot 9. Systems thinker, suspicious, patient and territorial. Skilled in low-light infrastructure repair, magnetic tissue anchoring and distributed sensory filaments. Arc: fortress-builder to systems unifier.

DT_NathanPrice.name: Nathan Price
DT_NathanPrice.role: Augment combat medic and augmentation engineer
DT_NathanPrice.visualAnchor: Recognizably human Augment with practical medical and technical modifications, neural-overclock interfaces and muscular-fiber graft evidence. His own maintenance should look slightly more worn or neglected than the careful work he performs on others, without making him visibly monstrous or terminally ill.
continuityLocks: Medical/technical augmentation should be practical and consistent
Subtle self-maintenance deterioration may accumulate only as scripted; do not prematurely age or deform him
DT_NathanPrice.notes: Kind at cost, funny under pressure, excellent technician and terrible patient. Hides progressive degradation. Arc: martyrdom to reciprocal/shared care.
